text:
Nora (Finance): Quick heads-up  ZurichMetrics (CH) invoiced us with Swiss VAT (7.7%) and also included a line saying \"withholding applied 8%\". Invoice ZM-2026-08 dated 2026-06-01. Can tax confirm whether either should apply?
Adrian (AP): Payment is scheduled today, held for review. Invoice shows net CHF 5,000; VAT CHF 385; withholding CHF 400 (weird).
ZurichMetrics (VendorBot): Uploaded invoice ZM-2026-08.pdf and tax docs: cert_ch_vat.pdf; vendor country=CH; VAT ID=CHE-123.456.789; bank=UBS CH.
Ilya (Tax): Switzerland VAT wouldn't apply for B2B services where place of supply is Ireland (our VAT ID IE9876543V), so vendor likely charged VAT in error. Withholding line is puzzling  Switzerland doesn't have a domestic withholding on cross-border services like that. We need vendor clarification and a corrected invoice/credit note.
Nora (Finance): Ask vendor to: (1) issue credit note cancelling VAT line and remove withholding line; (2) provide statement that services were B2B and net of Swiss VAT (include both VAT IDs); (3) confirm they won't remit VAT to Swiss authorities for this supply. Boilerplate below.
VendorOps: Sent message to vendor.
Nora (Finance): Boilerplate to vendor:
``
Hi <Name>,
Thanks for the invoice. We are VAT registered in Ireland (IE9876543V) and this is a B2B supply. Please: (1) issue a credit note cancelling ZM-2026-08 VAT CHF 385; (2) reissue a replacement invoice for net CHF 5,000 with VAT 0% and a note: \"Reverse charge applies\" quoting both VAT IDs; (3) remove any \"withholding\" line and confirm you will not remit VAT to Swiss tax authorities for this supply.
Thank you,
Nora, Redwood Finance
```
ZurichMetrics (VendorBot): Vendor replied: \"Apologies  our billing system flagged domestic rules. We'll send CN and corrected invoice by EOD and confirm treatment\"
Adrian (AP): Holding payment. Will process once CN + replacement received.
Ilya (Tax): After CN received, update vendor master to flag CH vendors as 'review VAT when customer EU VAT on file' and create TAX ticket to add validation to vendor onboarding.
Nora (Finance): @VendorOps please collect corrected docs and upload. We'll then post credit memo CM-2026-21 and resume payment.
VendorOps: Uploaded credit_note_CN-ZM-2026-08.pdf and invoice ZM-2026-08-RC.pdf.
Nora (Finance): Received. Creating CM-2026-21 to clear VAT line and mark tax code CH-RC-EXEMPT. Posting tomorrow. Closing after payment posts. :white_check_mark:
Ilya (Tax): I'll log for VAT audit trail. Keep copies of CN + replacement invoice.
Adrian (AP): Payment scheduled on corrected invoice tomorrow.
Nora (Finance): Thanks everyone.
